title: Reload failures and active configuration
summary: A failed reload can leave the previous configuration serving traffic. Relate change intent, reload outcome, worker lifecycle and measured routes instead of treating changed files as active-state proof.
checks: Correlate approved reload outcome and worker observations with route checks.
limitations: Automatic reload and production configuration validation are not installed.
applicability: Nginx master/worker lifecycle; live verified on 1.28

source.documentation_version: rolling documentation; features vary by build
